claims.statement: For every finite ordinary tree T, every original leaf v with original support s, and every integer p>=3 with |V(T)|<=2p+1, Delta_(p-1)(T-{v,s})-Delta_(p-1)(T-N_T[s])<=0, using integer zero-extended independence counts and original-tree neighborhoods.
claims.scope: Exactly the registered ordinary-leaf order band: finite simple connected acyclic T; original degree-one leaf and support; p>=3; |V(T)|<=2p+1. No favorable-selector, alpha, first-descent, lower-region, or residual premise. Informal proof audit only.
claims.reason: retained — the component-root property supplies a nonisolated marked root whenever H has an edge; the ordered-first-mark partition and adjacent-rank incidence bound then give q_(k+1)<=q_k since |J_i|<=2k-1. In the edgeless case W=V(H), and the binomial adjacent-layer inequality holds for |H|<=2k+1. The audit checks q_j=i_j(H)-i_j(R), k=p-1, zero extension and the exact graph-order bounds. This establishes only the informal registered pointwise order-band claim, not the first shell or the primary aggregate.
